items.title: What Is Coherent (COHR) Really Betting On With PhotonLink For AI Datacenters?
items.summary: Coherent (NYSE:COHR) introduced its PhotonLink integrated optics platform for next generation AI datacenters at ECOC 2026. PhotonLink consolidates Coherent photonics technologies into one platform for CPO, NPO, and chip to chip connectivity. The firm reported customer engagements already in progress and expects PhotonLink related revenue to begin ramping in late 2026.
